# Draft:Blaise Hayward

Blaise Hayward (born 1964) is an artist from Toronto, Canada who moved to New York in 1996.
After apprenticing for several Photographers in Toronto, Hayward opened his own studio in
1990 and starting working for various Advertising agencies and Canadas national newspaper,
The Globe and Mail. After arriving in New York Hayward signed with Creative Management
Partners and began a long career shooting Advertising campaigns, working with agencies such
as McGarry Bowen, Publicis, Grey, BBDO, McCann Erickson and DDB. He shot campaigns for
blue chip clients such as Verizon, JP Morgan Chase, Mastercard, Citi Bank and Pfizer.
In 2020, Hayward began focusing on his fine art, working in Bronze for his ‘Winter Trees’ series
and shooting portfolios including, The Honest Portrait, DUSK, Tickets Please, America The
Statehood Quarters and his Botanicals series – all of which are ongoing. He has also shot and
directed short movies including The Bicycle Rider and The Swimmer - focusing on people and
their passions.
In his spare time, he sings and plays guitar with his band Linden Farm and plays seasonal
concerts on the North Fork of Long Island. Hayward is also an avid cyclist.
